title: Fitts tells Tucker Carlson the money goes to space

tellings.quote: And I I believe in her Tucker Carlson interview she mentions your work and he's like, "Where is all this money going?" And she goes, "Well, talk to Richard Dolan." And she goes, "Space."

plain: In a television interview, the talk show host Tucker Carlson is said to have asked Katherine Austin Fitz where huge sums of missing government money were going, and she answered: "Space." Michels tells his guest, the writer Richard Dolan, that in the same interview she sent Carlson to Dolan's work, saying "talk to Richard Dolan." Michels recounts this from memory, as support for the idea that hidden money pays for a secret space effort.
